caption: The drawing depicts a single clear glass placed centrally on a plain, light-colored surface. The glass has a wide, open rim that tapers down to a narrow stem and then broadens again at the base. It is rendered in shades of grey and black, giving the illusion of transparency and reflection, with darker lines accentuating the contours and edges. Below and to the left of the glass is a shaded, circular shadow indicating a light source from the upper right. The background consists of an off-white, slightly yellowed tone with no additional objects or textures, and the composition is simple, focusing solely on the glass and its shadow.
title: Cordial Glass
